Problems & How to Fix

— 77/100

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.1 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.1 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 320 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (320 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

How to fix: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

Reduce unused CSS

Result: Est savings of 24 KiB

Why: The page is downloading resources that are not fully used during the initial page load. This increases network and processing work.

How to fix: Remove unused code, split CSS and JavaScript by page or feature, defer non-critical resources, and load assets only when they are needed.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.9 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.3 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.3 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,420 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,420 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.5 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

Result: Est savings of 35 KiB

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 35 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Document request latency

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 1,180 ms for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

Improve image delivery

Network dependency tree

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/network-dependency-tree) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

Render-blocking requests

Result: Est savings of 330 ms

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 330 ms for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.0 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

First Contentful Paint

Result: 5.3 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 5.3 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 6.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 6.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 720 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (720 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.9 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.9 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.8 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.6 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 14.9 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (14.9 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.1 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.1 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 24.9 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (24.9 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.2 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.2 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 26.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (26.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

Result: Est savings of 70 KiB

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 70 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.8 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 7.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 7.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 34.8 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (34.8 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.1 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.1 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 320 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (320 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.9 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.3 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.3 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,420 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,420 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

`button`, `link`, and `menuitem` elements do not have accessible names.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 6.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 6.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 720 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (720 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Largest Contentful Paint
